description: This file defines a React component 'FinalizedPersonaClient' which loads and displays a read-only view of a finalized persona, fetching data from APIs or local storage, and manages the presentation of persona details such as name, role, summary, competencies, and career highlights.

methods.name: isNonEmptyObject
methods.description: Type guard that checks if a value is a non-empty object.

methods.name: asStringArray
methods.description: Converts an unknown value to an array of trimmed strings, filtering out falsy values.

methods.name: coerceCareerHighlights
methods.description: Transforms input array into array of CareerHighlightItem objects, handling strings and objects.

methods.name: extractFinalPersonaFromOrchestrationRecord
methods.description: Extracts the final persona data from various possible fields in an orchestration record object.
